title: Tang Blue-and-White
version: Shipwrecked: Tang Treasures and Monsoon Winds, Smithsonian, pp. 208–211
lineage: Scholar’s interpretation of ceramics and maritime context; manufacture, intended market and proposed discontinuity are not direct evidence of a completed sale or a firm end date.

passages.note: Dates the Belitung ship departure around the second quarter of the ninth century and identifies three complete blue-and-white dishes in the cargo.
Describes Gongxian blue-painted white stonewares as a short-lived export-oriented branch, technically distinct from later Jingdezhen production.
